meta.description: Tierradentro is a non-profit live performance production company based in Toulouse, France: touring projects, concert dates and a press and venue area.

accueil.accroche: A non-profit that supports artists from creation to touring, with shows ready to travel and up-to-date technical riders.
accueil.introTexte: Tierradentro comes from the Spanish "tierra adentro": inland, the heart of the land. We produce projects that come from there, and we take them wherever they are awaited.
accueil.proTexte: All documents, up to date, ready to download. No account, no password.
